description:
Mapjects Web and Mobile Developer UI : 

 

 This position is responsible for growing the business, building relationships with customer, showcasing value, TCO, ROI, closing deals, negotiating, performing demo's. 
 

 

 email word copy (preferred) of resume to : dev@mapjects.com 

 or        jobs@mapjects.com 

 

 Mapjects is looking for a responsible, driven, savvy, developer to refactor and bring a consistent/cohesive look and feel. We're looking for someone who has ideas, and can deliver..
 

 

 This role is designed for the ultimate, Über-Frontend UX/UI, who knows for a fact what’s hot and what’s not.  

 

 What we offer you 

 The ability to make a difference: Our clients range from small startups to large multi-billion software corporations. Your involvement on a day-to-day basis will help our clients succeed.

 

 Visibility: Our clients have major brand products in the marketplace. You could walk into a store and see what you have been working on for the last six months.

 

 Variety: New clients, new projects, new environments, new challenges, new tools for your toolbelt.

 Growth: With the variety of expertise in-house, you will have the opportunity to learn many new technologies. We strive to provide each of our developers with a path to becoming a senior-level programmer.

 

 The “what’s next”: We are working on business development constantly and moving our company forward. If our clients need something that is new and uncharted we say “game on.”

 

 Work/life balance: Have friends? Family? We do too! Projects are scoped and proposed how they should be. Late hours and weekends are an exception not the norm.

 

 What are we looking for? 

 
 A fundamental and thorough understanding of OOP

 Detail oriented and passionate about development

 Familiar with UI/UX best practices

 Skilled in Objective-C & iOS API’s and/or Java & Android API’s

 Skilled in web development and front-end technologies (HTML, JavaScript, CSS)

 Established principles for what makes for high quality code

 Be prepared and open to learn something new

 
 

 Skills that will make you shine: 

 
 Understanding and experience with test driven development

 Participates in open source community / project contributor

 Familiar with newer technologies (MongoDB, NodeJS, Bootstrap, SASS, Backbone)

 Be able to work in more than one language. (PHP, .NET, Objective-C, Java, JavaScript, Python, Flex, Ruby, C++)

 Familiarity with team-based development (source control, documentation, QA, Scrum)

 Being a front-end guru (Complete understanding of HTML/CSS/JavaScript/DOM)

 Server management experience (Linux, Windows)

 Advanced OOP - patterns, methodologies, strategies

 
 Requirements: 

 
 Hands-on experience with mobile application software development for the iPhone and Android Platform

 Experience with Adobe Photoshop

 Experience integrating mobile applications to Web Services

 3-5+ Years of professional experience in popular backend technology (PHP, Ruby, Python, .NET)

 Solid working knowledge of REST, JSON, XML, Web Services and object-oriented techniques

 College degree or relevant work experience (CS or CIS preferred, but not required)

 
 
 This is a great opportunity to join a winning team. Mapjects offers a competitive compensation package with opportunities for growth and professional development. 

We wish to thank all applicants for their interest and effort in applying for this position, however, only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.

 Daily Skills 
- Strong Business Accume/Analysis/ client facing
- Communicational skills 

 Some of the positions require work to be performed in DC, or VA

 

 Education
- BS in an Information Systems or some equiv related field of study at Mapjects, we're a team of builders. 

 please email word copy of resume to 

 ensure it has your contact information, and phone number to reach you. 

 

 jobs@mapjects.com
